outcome: anterior resting potential (ARP) of the puborectalis, pubococcygeus, and urethral sphincter muscles
cohort: The study included 157 postpartum women who underwent follow-up examinations between April 2021 and August 2022.
finding: The severity of Diastasis Recti Abdominis (DRA) significantly affects EMG parameters related to muscle tone in specific pelvic floor muscles, particularly the anterior resting potential (ARP) of the puborectalis, pubococcygeus, and urethral sphincter.
cross-section timing: postpartum, with examinations conducted between April 2021 and August 2022
